question: GQ-001
subject: the selection filter did not remove what had already been fetched
the_gap: build-want-list gained a correspondence filter, but build-external-passages reads the TEXT DIRECTORY, not the want-list. The 13 manuscript letters already on the vault would have entered the index on the next rebuild regardless.
verified_they_are_not_indexed_yet: 0 Cheyney books and 0 passages in the current index — the last rebuild predates that fetch
the_fix: the builder now skips the same pattern at index time, counts it separately in corpus_stats, and rebuild-corpus adds BOTH skip categories when reconciling catalogue against index
nothing_deleted: the files stay on the vault; they are simply not indexed

a_hardcoded_path_that_bit_immediately.what: my first fixture test reported 0 correspondence skipped
a_hardcoded_path_that_bit_immediately.why: the builder read BOOKS from a hardcoded path, so it took titles from the REAL catalogue instead of the fixture — and the fixture had no rows
a_hardcoded_path_that_bit_immediately.note: seven other builders had already been moved to lib/vault-paths.mjs for exactly this reason; this one was missed
a_hardcoded_path_that_bit_immediately.fix: BOOKS_DB override, which is what made the skip testable at all

a_number_that_would_have_misled_later: the builder logged "from 5 books" while indexing 2. rebuild-corpus greps that line, and it reads as a corpus size in a worklog a week later. Now: "from 2 books (3 correspondence skipped)".
